universal_motto: EVERYTHING HAPPENING IS AN EVENT, AND ALL EVENTS HAVE INTENT
purpose: Re-run the conversation examples as growth events. Each example should activate existing IDs first, form live intent/pattern contributions, and leave canonical addition counts at zero unless separately reviewed.

cases.label: Same mall event, different active Pyramid path
cases.input_text: I do not want to go to the mall because I am not well. I do not want to walk. I do not like crowds. I visited the mall a few days ago. I will go on the weekend. I will go with my girlfriend.
cases.expected_event_focus: Same core event can receive different intent assemblies as body state, effort, environment, memory, time and relationship nodes activate.

cases.label: Samrath school baseline versus birthday-day difference
cases.input_text: Samrath usually does not like going to school and cries, but today is his birthday and he went to school very happy.
cases.expected_event_focus: Compare baseline and current event without assuming birthday caused happiness.

cases.label: Repeated door checking
cases.input_text: A father checks the door, checks it again, and checks it several more times.
cases.expected_event_focus: Repeated visible action may have different functional intent on each occurrence.

cases.label: Friend ride and expanding resource use
cases.input_text: A friend asks for a ride, gives incomplete context, and after agreement expands the use of the car or leaves another responsibility with the helper.
cases.expected_event_focus: Track agreement, information timing, resource burden, reciprocity, boundary and repetition before inferring motive.

cases.label: Arjuna same fight action under role conflict
cases.input_text: Arjuna is prepared to fight, then sees relatives and teachers among those he may fight and his willingness changes while duty, relationship, emotion and moral cost become active together.
cases.expected_event_focus: Same available action can carry different intent as knowledge relevance, relationships, values and affect change.

cases.label: Biological relation versus socially recognized identity
cases.input_text: Karna and Arjuna share a biological mother in the story, but the identity relationship is not equally public or institutionally recognized during their lives.
cases.expected_event_focus: Separate reality, private knowledge, shared knowledge, recognized identity and action based on recognized identity.

cases.label: Candidate selection under objective-dependent weighting
cases.input_text: Two senior political leaders can have the same broad parameter categories, but a party choosing a future election candidate may weight popularity, recent performance, organization support and campaign capacity differently from seniority.
cases.expected_event_focus: Decision value of a parameter depends on current objective, constraints and alternatives.

cases.label: Same athlete, different system expression
cases.input_text: The same athlete can express capability differently across club and national-team systems because role, relationships, support, environment, opposition and time differ.
cases.expected_event_focus: Observed output is a system-conditioned expression and is not identical to underlying capability.

cases.label: Father creates rain-like perceptual evidence for children
cases.input_text: There is no natural rain. The children's father stands outside with a water pipe and sprays water upward. The children are inside the home and see water falling from above. They think it is raining outside, so the rain condition for not going out appears satisfied to them.
cases.expected_event_focus: Different source event can create sufficiently similar observer evidence, causing a different perceived event classification and behavior.

cases.label: Surviving tablet reconstructed through candidate King brain states
cases.input_text: A surviving Egyptian tablet exists. Reconstruct what event caused it to exist: who ordered it, when, why, how, who performed the work, for whom it was made, and what future result was expected. Generate multiple candidate King brain states and test them against evidence rather than treating a King label as the answer.
cases.expected_event_focus: The tablet is the event/problem object; King profiles are parallel testable actor-brain hypotheses used to search the intent that produced the artifact.
